example.en: We deeply respect this scientist who has made great contributions to the country.

example.zh: 在讨论中，我们应该尊重每个人的不同意见。
example.pinyin: Zài tǎolùn zhōng, wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng měi ge rén de bùtóng yìjiàn.
example.en: In discussions, we should respect everyone's different opinions.
